content:
For \(k=1\): each bouquet has \(24\) flowers. Total flowers \(=21+91+37+67=216\). Using all flowers would require \(216/24=9\) bouquets, but \(9\) bouquets need \(9\cdot 3=27\) white tulips, and only \(21\) are available.

For \(k=2\): each bouquet has \(48\) flowers. Using all flowers would require \(216/48=4.5\) bouquets, impossible.

Thus no valid identical bouquets can be made without leaving flowers out.
